Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL262 (Glycogen synthase kinase-3 beta). Filter to exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary; require compound_structures for canonical SMILES. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
